positive: An existing site or codebase needs improvement while preserving its intended identity
A redesign request has inspectable rendered or source evidence
negative: A greenfield project needs direction before anything exists to inspect
A request is only a single specialist repair with no site-level diagnosis

exclusions: Do not prescribe or edit before inspecting evidence
Do not perform a material redesign without explicit approval

outputs.primary: An evidence-labelled inferred system, readiness decision, and scoped repair plan or implementation report

stop_conditions: Pause when evidence is insufficient for a safe inference
Pause for explicit approval before a material redesign
Ask no more than three questions that each change implementation
